verdict.rationale: Attio markets a built-in assistant, "Ask Attio," that searches, updates and creates records. Per its marketing, it also drafts follow-ups, schedules next steps, creates account briefs and builds workflows from a described goal. Embedded agents (Web, Scoring, Routing and Custom Agents) handle delegated work on deals. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the assistant's capabilities, limits and permissions (the evidence is marketing copy only), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
